text: This report includes several detailed appendices that provide a full financial summary of all program areas of Exhibition Place for the second quarter ending June 30, 2021.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 14, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
